description: Start a personal streak for any habit with Perkadoo's Streak Badge, no account needed. Returns a public streak page, a live SVG badge for a README or website, and a private check-in link. The check-in link is the only way to check in, so tell the person to save it.

ownerName.description: Whose streak it is, shown on the public page.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone that decides when a day starts, e.g. Europe/London. Default UTC.

title.description: The habit, e.g. 'Read 20 pages' or 'Ship a commit'.

name: create_streak_badge
title: Start a streak badge
